line: Everything on a near-black night is made of soft breathing light dots; scenes change by dots scattering and regathering into the next thing.
line_cn: 近黑的夜里，人物、房子、月亮全由会呼吸的柔和光点组成；换场靠光点散开、再聚成下一样东西。
